To determine the answers for the foundation wall:

1. **Calculate the perimeter of the foundation:**
   $\text{Perimeter} = 48\text{ ft} + 48\text{ ft} + 40\text{ ft} + 40\text{ ft} = 176\text{ ft}$ (or $2,112\text{ in}$).

2. **Calculate the number of blocks per course:**
   Each nominal CMU is $16\text{ in}$ long.
   $\text{Blocks per course} = \frac{2,112\text{ in}}{16\text{ in}} = 132\text{ blocks}$.

3. **Calculate the number of courses:**
   The wall is $4\text{ ft}$ high ($48\text{ in}$). Each nominal CMU is $8\text{ in}$ high.
   $\text{Number of courses} = \frac{48\text{ in}}{8\text{ in}} = 6\text{ courses}$.

4. **Total CMUs without waste:**
   $132 \times 6 = 792\text{ CMUs}$.

5. **Q1. CMUs with 6% waste:**
   $792 \times 1.06 = 839.52$, which rounds up to $840\text{ CMUs}$.

6. **Q2. Fully grouted grout volume with 5% waste:**
   Total grout volume = $792\text{ blocks} \times 0.17\text{ ft}^3/\text{block} = 134.64\text{ ft}^3$.
   Including 5% waste: $134.64 \times 1.05 = 141.372\text{ ft}^3$.
   Converting to cubic yards: $\frac{141.372}{27} \approx 5.24\text{ CY}$.

7. **Q3. Spaced reinforcement (32 in o.c.) grout volume with 5% waste:**
   Vertical reinforcement spaced at $32\text{ in}$ on center means grouting every 2nd cell (since cells are every $16\text{ in}$).
   Number of grouted cells = $\frac{2,112\text{ in}}{32\text{ in}} \times 6\text{ courses} = 66 \times 6 = 396\text{ cells}$.
   Grout volume = $396 \times 0.17\text{ ft}^3 = 67.32\text{ ft}^3$.
   Including 5% waste: $67.32 \times 1.05 = 70.686\text{ ft}^3$.
   Converting to cubic yards: $\frac{70.686}{27} \approx 2.62\text{ CY}$.

FINAL: Q1 = 840 CMU
FINAL: Q2 = 5.24 CY
FINAL: Q3 = 2.62 CY
